fusions.name: Drop-Forge Rhythm
fusions.desc: A quick downstroke that deals 5 damage and leaves the target 5% easier to wound for 4 seconds.

fusions.name: Pressed Flat
fusions.desc: Rolls a crushing weight out around you that deals 32 damage to every enemy within 3 tiles, ignoring their armour.

fusions.name: Full Swing Wound Up
fusions.desc: Increases your critical damage by 30% for 12 seconds.

fusions.name: Each Blow Drives On
fusions.desc: When you land a critical hit, your physical damage rises by 25% for 4 seconds. Once every 10 seconds.
